status: Published rounded aggregate arithmetic and hypothetical hazard scaling, not an otter effect estimate
limitations: No local otter-to-seed recruitment effect measured
Depth observations are short-term and rounded; observed zero consumption is not proof of zero true risk
Assumed proportional hazard and hypothetical hazard changes are not estimated from crab CPUE
Field exclosure manipulates predator access, not otters or one predator species alone
Seed-rain contrasts are from separate sites in China; do not multiply across studies to estimate a realized cascade
